subject: Full loop: panel stitch, staggered slots, and interruptible debrief plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acme-recruit.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Full loop: panel stitch, staggered slots, and interruptible debrief plan

Hi all —

We need to lock Asha Rao's virtual onsite (full loop) for next Wednesday. Sonia confirmed the candidate prefers morning windows. To reduce churn I sketched a staggered / interruptible flow so we can keep momentum if a panel runs long. Attach: asha_rao_resume.pdf.

Proposed schedule (PST):
- 09:00–09:30: 30m intro / culture (Laura + Recruiting) — Zoom main room
- 09:35–10:05: 30m Systems design (Karthik) — breakout A
- 09:40–10:00: 20m Product/PM sensemaking (Logan) — breakout B (starts overlapping with Systems)
- 10:10–10:35: 25m Implementation / backend deeper dive (Neha) — breakout A (continues if Systems overruns)
- 10:40–11:10: 30m Behavioral / leadership (Laura) — Zoom main room

Key constraints / rules:
- If Systems runs >35m, the Implementation slot should be interruptible: Neha will grab the candidate at 10:10 and pick up with a trimmed rubric concentrating on APIs + correctness.
- We should run a 10-minute debrief directly after the last slot (11:10–11:20) with everyone on the main room; hiring manager to call decision.
- Backup: if Karthik is delayed, we run the product slot fully and swap System/Implementation cadence (Neha covers core design prompts).

Actions for internal panel: please reply with 1) ack/availability 2) which rubric anchors you will own (design depth, tradeoffs, infra, testing, product fit) 3) whether you need any tailoring to question set.

Sonia — can you confirm candidate's timezone (we have PST) and confirm Asha can do 09:00–11:20 PST? Also please send calendar invite when we lock.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: asha_rao_resume.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Full loop: panel stitch, staggered slots, and interruptible debrief plan

Ack — I can take Systems design. Two quick asks:
1) Can I shift my slot 5 minutes earlier (09:30–10:00) so I start just after the intro and reduce overlap with product? That makes the handoff cleaner.
2) Uploading my eval form as I prefer the team to use the standard "design + constraints + follow-ups" scoring grid (attached eval-guide.docx).

If I'm running long, I recommend we let Neha run the Implementation slot with a trimmed prompt and we mark the Systems deep-dive as follow-up loop.

-Karthik
Principal Engineer
Attachments: eval-guide.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acme-recruit.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Updated schedule + debrief ownership and contingency notes

Thanks all for the quick replies — locking updates below and adding explicit rubrics.

Final schedule (PST):
- 09:00–09:30 — Intro / culture (Laura + Sonia) — Zoom main
- 09:30–10:00 — Systems design (Karthik) — Breakout A
- 09:35–09:55 — Product sensemaking (Logan) — Breakout B (shortened to 20m)
- 10:10–10:35 — Implementation / backend (Neha) — Breakout A (interruptible)
- 10:40–11:10 — Behavioral & hiring manager (Laura) — Zoom main
- 11:10–11:20 — Rapid debrief (all) — Zoom main (Laura to lead)

Coverage plan:
- Karthik will own design depth + tradeoffs; use the "eval-guide" rubric for scoring.
- Logan please post the 3-question checklist by EOD Tuesday — short, consistent prompts we can run when overlap happens.
- Neha will maintain an interruptible Implementation rubric (focus: API correctness, failure modes, testing strategy).

Contingency rules:
- If Systems overruns into 10:00+, Neha should start Implementation with the trimmed rubric and call out any design gaps to Karthik in the debrief.
- If Karthik is >10m late, swap Systems/Implementation and run product full-length; inform candidate via chat.

I've created a shared candidate packet and added permissions: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xcandidate-packet (please use live annotations). Calendar invites will follow.

Attachments: candidate-packet-drive-link.txt

Marissa

Logan — happy to take a 5–7m cross-check at end of my slot if Karthik needs to handoff partial answers.

See you all Wednesday.
